topic: Snohvit Future electrification/onshore-compression project — Dec 2025 schedule slip and cost increase
wiki_text: In a 22 December 2025 status update, Equinor said the Snohvit Future project (onshore compression plus shore-power electrification of Hammerfest LNG, sanctioned 2022 and approved by the Norwegian government in Aug 2023) is roughly halfway complete but has slipped about a year: onshore compression is now expected to start in 2029 (previously 2028) and electrification from 2030. The cost estimate has risen to more than NOK 20 billion (2025 values), up from NOK 13.2 billion at the 2022 plan-for-development submission (about NOK 14.7 billion inflation-adjusted) and roughly NOK 4 billion higher than the 2024 estimate, driven by inflation, equipment-procurement costs and the difficulty of executing a large project inside an operating plant (including 2025 turnaround/safety shutdowns). The project is intended to extend Hammerfest LNG operations toward 2050 and cut CO2 emissions by ~850,000 t/yr. Plant nameplate remains 4.2 mtpa (the upgrade preserves rather than expands output). [CONFIRMED]
